scenes.title: A Sapper's Choice and a Late-Night Dessert
scenes.summary: Max compares deciding whether to tell a bitter truth to defusing a bomb, while late at night Vika complains about lingering guests and learns Louis is making a special dessert for a lady.

scenes.title: Senya and Fedya's Three-Thousand-Ruble Bet
scenes.summary: Max apologizes to Vika at the end of the night, and the next morning Senya and Fedya make a three-thousand-ruble bet over Louis's late-night walk with the female guest.

scenes.title: Kostya and Sasha's Morning Panic
scenes.summary: After a drunken night, Kostya and Sasha wake up in horror in the same bed, and Sasha begs Kostya not to confess to Max right as Max walks into the apartment.

scenes.title: Max Apologizes for His Jealousy
scenes.summary: At the bar, Max apologizes to a guilt-ridden Kostya for making a scene over Ilya the night before, while Nastya hands Max a drink to cheer him up.

scenes.title: The Chef's Strange Mood
scenes.summary: In the locker room and kitchen corridor, Senya and Fedya try to figure out why Chef Barinov is barking orders and acting even crazier than usual.

scenes.title: The Aquarium and Elena's Request
scenes.summary: Elena drops by the restaurant without warning, admires Chef Barinov's new aquarium, and convinces him to visit her busy friend with her.

scenes.title: Max and Sasha Make Up
scenes.summary: Max apologizes to Sasha for being jealous of Ilya and gives her a peace offering, while Kostya urgently whispers to Sasha that they must tell Max the truth.

scenes.title: Louis's Admirer and Meeting Tamara
scenes.summary: The female guest from the previous night returns to see Louis as Senya demands his bet money back from Fedya, while Elena introduces Viktor Petrovich to Tamara Ivanovna.

scenes.title: At the Psychologist's Office
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich assumes Tamara Ivanovna wants to order a banquet until he realizes Elena brought him to anger-management therapy, causing him to lose his temper on the spot.

scenes.title: Poetry Against Anger and Advice for Louis
scenes.summary: Tamara teaches Chef Barinov to recite poetry whenever rage strikes, while in the kitchen Max advises Louis on how to gently turn down his persistent female admirer.

scenes.title: An Awkward Lunch and the Chef's Winter Moon
scenes.summary: Max cheerfully invites Kostya to sit with him and Sasha to celebrate their friendship, while Chef Barinov stuns the kitchen by reciting Pushkin instead of yelling.

scenes.title: Louis's Confession in the Storage Room
scenes.summary: Louis tries to tell his female admirer in the storage room that nothing can happen between them after their one night together, just as Chef Barinov barges in reciting poetry.

scenes.title: Kostya's Guilty Conscience and Nastya's Clue
scenes.summary: The female guest mistakes Chef Barinov for Louis's jealous boyfriend, while Kostya tells Sasha he must confess everything to Max just before Nastya spots Sasha's socks.

scenes.title: A Button in the Dessert
scenes.summary: A guest discovers a button baked into her dessert and demands to see the pastry chef and head chef, interrupting Nastya just as she tries to warn Max.

scenes.title: Kitchen Rumors and Nastya's Ultimatum
scenes.summary: Louis recognizes his button in the guest's dessert as Senya and Fedya spread wild rumors to Nastya, who then confronts Sasha and orders her to tell Max the truth.

scenes.title: Nastya Opens Max's Eyes
scenes.summary: Nastya tells Max at the bar that Kostya is cheating on her with Sasha, and when Max goes to check, he overhears Kostya demanding that Sasha confess to him.

scenes.title: A Chain Reaction of Revelations
scenes.summary: Max punches Kostya in the corridor, and as Kostya tries to defend himself, he accidentally blurts out that Sasha had also cheated on Max with Ilya.

scenes.title: Kitchen Explosion and the Ruins of Truth
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov's poetry therapy collapses as Vika accuses him of chasing Louis, leaving Max to reflect on how reckless actions and bitter truths leave only ruins behind.
